Since 2018, we have brought carbon frame production back to Italy, restarting manufacturing at our Presezzo facility, where we now produce a complete range of high-performance carbon frames and bicycles. We offer these bikes in two versions:
ITALIA
and
ITALIA X
.
In Italy, we go from design through production. From limited editions to full-series models. From gravel to road, built for racing and adventure. Driven by passion, we build the bikes of the future.
